tool_args.rationale: The prior barrier law failed fresh confirmation, while the archive identifies the transformed inland-hub siphon as a close competing family. The branch probe expanded the sink-gradient range and resolved the open square-root branch; fit the three-parameter static siphon law numerically to all seven paid observations.

considered_alternatives.option: Acquire another open-branch or fine-trajectory probe
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The open-branch probe has already supplied low- and high-gradient observations, bringing the dataset to seven rows at the target horizon; remaining uncertainty is better addressed by fitting the stationary siphon law.
Its earlier numerical fit was decisively refuted on fresh confirmation, and a multistart retry does not address that poor functional match.

All observations share one horizon and fixed x_now/mem_conv, so a trajectory batch would be needed to identify that more complex model; the observed signatures and targeted branch probe instead favor the static siphon family.
